P11.rationale: Two donut/ring charts displaying real cited percentages (58% and 61% from KPMG 2026) are present and bound to specific numbers, though the visualisation is limited to just this one small panel rather than multiple data points or richer chart types.

P12.rationale: The layout has a large blank zone in the lower-middle of the page between the chart panel and the footer CTA block, leaving significant white space that makes the sheet feel under-filled compared to the dense, column-packed reference layouts.
